`_bmad-output/architecture.md` — 20 numbered decisions (AR-1..AR-20), Vietnamese to match the PRD.

The memlog showed a prior run that logged its finalize but never landed the file, so I resumed from it rather than re-deriving. Three things changed on resume: the adversarial lens found five pairs of units that could obey every AR and still build incompatibly (orphan `NoteTag` rows, soft-delete eating tags so FR-3 restore breaks, worker polling vs. push, double-applied filter/sort, export governed by nothing) — four ARs tightened, AR-20 added; AR-19 added because the operational envelope was silent; and both `lint_spine.py` and `sed` were denied, so the linter's rule set was applied by hand and recorded as such.

The load-bearing call is AR-7 + AR-8: they resolve the NFR-1 vs NFR-2 conflict `addendum.md` §B flagged as unsolved — index persisted and updated incrementally (never rebuilt at startup), worker loaded after first paint. The search algorithm itself is deliberately left open with AR-16 as the gate.

Gate verdict is PASS with reservations, and it is self-review, not independent — subagents are forbidden this session, so the same agent wrote and reviewed. Stack versions could not be web-verified (WebSearch denied); they're tagged `[ASSUMPTION]` with major lines fixed and exact versions deferred to lockfile at scaffold.
